_comment: Analytics was the first service migrated off RabbitMQ (BRD §15) and consumes exclusively via Kafka (topic per kart-conventions.md's kart.<service>.<entity> naming), with its own Kafka dead-letter topics for post-ingestion failures (design-decisions.md's D5). It owns no RabbitMQ exchange, DLX, or queue — every event it ingests is dual-published to Kafka by that event's own owning service from that service's own RabbitMQ exchange (see each producer's own message-bus-manifest.json).
